subject: general
question: In the Rajya Sabha, how many members are nominated by the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__12.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajya Sabha:**

 
 
• The Rajya Sabha was **constituted on 3 April 1952, **but it **met for the first time on 13 May 1952.**
 
• As India has** a bicameral legislature**, the** Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Parliament.**
 
• The Vice-President serves as the Rajya Sabha's ex-officio chairman.
 
• According to the **Representation of People's Act, of 1951, **each **member has a tenure of 6 years** which can be reduced by the President.
 
• The **4th schedule** of the constitution deals with the **distribution of seats among the states and Union territories.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Rajya Sabha** was created by the** Indian constitution's** creators as a check on the authority of the** Lok Sabha**, the lower chamber of the **legislature**. The interests of the states and union territories are represented.
 
• There can be a maximum of **250 members** of the **Rajya Sabha**, the majority of whom are chosen for **six-year** terms by the** legislative bodies **of the **states **and **union territories**; **12 **are chosen by the **Indian president**.
 
• The **Rajya Sabha** has similar authority to the** Lok Sabha**. Any house can introduce the** majority of bills**. They need to be passed by **both houses **and the** president of India** in order to become law.
